Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Deandra Dottin and Rashada Williams will open the batting for West Indies Women. Darcie Brown will begin the proceedings with the bat. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is a huge one, Australia Women should defend this with the bowling unit they have. West Indies Women, on the other hand, need the openers to not only get them off to a flier but put up a huge stand. Can there be a fight back? We will find out. Stay tuned for the run chase!

Alyssa Healy is down for a chat. She says it wasn’t easy to start, she does not think it is a flat wicket, there is extra bounce and she feels 300 is a pretty good score. Adds that Haynes is a calming influence and they knew if they hung in there they would cash in. Ends by saying it is not the easiest wicket, there was a tennis ball-like bounce and she hopes they can defend the target.

West Indies Women began well with the ball, they managed to trouble the Aussie batters and also kept it tight early on but once the two openers got going, they just had no answers. Stafanie Taylor tried as many as 7 bowlers but none of them could stop the run flow and things just fell apart for them with many catch drops as well. Out of the lot though, Chinelle Henry was the pick with two wickets but West Indies Women will be pretty disappointed with their performance.

Stafanie Taylor probably did so keeping the condition in mind, they wanted wickets with the new ball but they had to wait for 216 runs to get their first wicket. Both Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes weathered the storm early and as the game went ahead, batting became easier and the two made full use of the conditions. Healy was at her sublime best scoring a brilliant ton and Haynes played as the perfect foil. Once Healy fell, two more fell quickly but the stand between Mooney and Lanning ensured Australia crossed 300.
End of a brilliant batting performance from Australia Women and we feel they have batted the Windies out of the game. Stafanie Taylor will be rueing her decision to bowl first.
Fuller ball, around middle. Beth Mooney pushes it towards mid off and takes a single. Good last over for West Indies Women, 5 runs off it. Australia Women end at 305/3!
On a length, outside off. Meg Lanning pushes it towards point for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning makes room and looks to upper cut this but she misses.
Fuller, outside off. Beth Mooney dabs it towards point for a quick single.
Back of a length, around middle. Beth Mooney pulls it towards deep square leg. Deandra Dottin does well to stop the ball and keep it to two runs.
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Beth Mooney backs away and tries to upper cut this but she misses.
Tosses it up, full, outside off. Meg Lanning looks to sweep this but she misses.

Shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning pulls it towards deep square leg. Rashada Williams runs to her left, dives, and stops the ball from touching the boundary ropes. Good effort from her! Two taken! That brings up the 300 for Australia Women!
Slower through the air, full, around middle and leg. Meg Lanning works it away towards deep square leg for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning cuts it towards point.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Beth Mooney pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Loopy delivery, full and outside off. Beth Mooney sweeps it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to her left and makes a half-stop. Two taken!
A single to end but a huge over. 16 from it. On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
FOUR! Three in a row! On the leg side this time! This is short and on the body, it is pulled over square leg and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! One brings two! Mooney steps out again and this time also makes room. She hits it wide of long off, more towards cover for a boundary. She is extremely strong in that region.
FOUR! Up and over! Finally a boundary. Picks her spot well. Mooney comes down the track and lofts this over mid off and bags a boundary.
Safe! Shorter and on middle, Lanning looks to pull, this goes offf the top edge but lands safe in the square leg region for one.
Excellent running! Can take one for the throw on this big ground. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Lands short! On middle, Lanning looks to go big, it goes off the inner half down to long on for one.
Just the one as this is hit down to long off.
Two dots in a row! Mooney steps out and makes room but hits it straight to cover.
A dot! Short and outside off, Mooney looks to cut but misses.
Two twos to begin! On off, Mooney lifts it wide of long off and takes two. Not easy to hit boundaries on this big ground so running between the wickets become important.
Tossed up outside off, this is dragged through mid-wicket for a couple.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Well fielded! Two. Mooney chips it towards mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to her right, dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for her side.
Shorter and on the body, Meg pulls it through square leg for one.
Flatter and angled into the pads, Lanning looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads.
Mooney comes down the track and hits it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
A single to end then. Just the 5 from the over. On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Just short! Mooney comes down the track and plays it towards cover. The fielder there goes down on her knees too quickly. It lands just short. A dot.
Dealing in singles in this over! Shorter and outside off, Lanning chops it to point for a quick single.
Mooney steps out but does not get to the pitch of the ball, she plays it with soft hands on the off side for one.
Fires this one on off, it is guided to point for one.
Full this time, around middle, flatter ball once again. Meg Lanning drills it towards long on for a single.
Flatter, shorter, around middle. Beth Mooney works it away towards square leg for a single.
Very full on this occasion, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it past cover for a brace.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Beth Mooney scoops this towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Pitches it up, around middle. Meg Lanning knocks it to long on and rotates the strike.
Full again, around middle. Beth Mooney dances down the ground and flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.

NO BALL! Fullish delivery, around middle and off. Meg Lanning steps down and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single. Karishma Ramharack has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free-hit coming up!
Fuller, around middle. Beth Mooney pushes it back to the bowler.
Another length delivery, around middle and leg. Beth Mooney heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Meg Lanning taps it towards point and takes a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it to the fielder at cover-point.
Quick single! On a length, outside off. Beth Mooney dabs it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, around middle. Beth Mooney defends it out.
Wide of off, shorter in length. Meg Lanning slashes it uppishly over backward point for a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Beth Mooney flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, wide of off. Beth Mooney guides it towards third man for a brace.
Another shorter ball, width on offer again. Meg Lanning cuts it past point for a single.
FOUR! WOW, What a shot this is by Meg Lanning! This is short, wide of off. Meg Lanning slaps it over backward point for a cracking boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Meg Lanning leaves it alone.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Chinelle Henry has two wickets in this over! West Indies Women are pulling things back at the end. Ashleigh Gardner departs early. On a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner stays back and looks to push this away on the off side. The ball goes off the outside edge towards the keeper. Shemaine Campbelle grabs it safely. Beth Mooney walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shemaine Campbelle b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! CUT AWAY! Another length ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner slashes it past point for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it towards point.
Fuller, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it through cover for a single.
Very full, on middle. Meg Lanning defends it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies Women have got their second wicket! Chinelle Henry gets rid of another set batter. Deandra Dottin holds on to this one! A fuller ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes stays low and drives it uppishly towards Deandra Dottin at cover, who pouches it safely. A fine knock comes to an end by Rachael Haynes. Meg Lanning comes to the crease now.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another bouncer, around middle. Rachael Haynes makes room and tries to upper cut this but she misses.
Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Another short ball, outside off, slower ball. Rachael Haynes backs away and tries to go over on the off side but she misses.
Shorter again, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls this but the ball goes off the edge and onto her helmet towards point. Singe taken! The physio is out there to check on her!
FOUR! Edgy runs! On a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to push this away, but the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper for a boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner cuts it towards point.
In the air...and safe! Fuller ball, angling away, around off. Rachael Haynes tries to heave this, but the ball goes off the top edge and lands in between two fielders at mid-off.
Fuller now, around middle and off. Ashleigh Gardner pushes it towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, wide of off. Ashleigh Gardner slashes it towards deep cover for a brace. She gets off the mark!
Fuller ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes drills it down to long off for a single.
Another short delivery, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single. She retains the strike!
A shorter ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes looks to pull but she misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, West Indies Women have a wicket! They have managed to grab on to this one! Shamilia Connell strikes and gets rid of Alyssa Healy. A fine innings comes to an end. This was a shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy dances down the ground and tries to slap this over mid off, but the ball goes off the toe-end of the ball, towards mid off. Shakera Selman (sub) runs forward and takes a good catch this time. Ashleigh Gardner comes to the crease now.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shakera Selman b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! On a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy tonks it over mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy clips it towards fine leg for a single.

ANOTHER DROP CATCH! Oh, dear! Another dolly goes down and another chance gone begging. A fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy lifts it towards long on. Shakera Selman (sub) runs forward and gets her hands to the ball, but fails to get hold of it. Single taken!
Shorter, wide of off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A shorter ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep square leg for a cracking boundary.
On a length, around middle. Alyssa Healy tucks it towards square leg for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy whips it towards deep mid-wicket. Deandra Dottin runs to her left, tries to stop the ball, but the ball goes through her towards the ropes for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point.
Full, on middle. Alyssa Healy sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length. Alyssa Healy chops it past point towards third man for a couple of runs. That is the highest partnership in this World Cup!
Shorter ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Alyssa Healy advances down the pitch and drives it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! And again! Back-to-back boundaries for Alyssa Healy! Fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy shuffles across and swipes it towards deep square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Swept away! Fuller ball, tosses it up, on middle. Alyssa Healy gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary!
FOUR! Rachael Haynes joins the party now! A loopy ball, full, around middle. Rachael Haynes dances down the pitch and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, loopy delivery, around off. Alyssa Healy steps down and tries to lift it over covers but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a brace.
Fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps this past point for two runs!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it through square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

There it is! Shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy slashes it towards point and takes a single. 100 for Alyssa Healy! What an innings this has been from her! This is her first century in World Cups!
Around middle, fuller ball, Blocked out.
Full, on middle. Alyssa Healy blocks it out.
Another full ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, shorter ball. Alyssa Healy punches it towards cover for a single. She is on 99 now!
Fuller ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy takes full advantage of it! A fuller ball, on middle. Alyssa Healy dances down the track and lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
NO BALL AND SIX! High and hand!  A full toss, around off. Alyssa Healy dances down the pitch and slaps it high over long off for a biggie! She moves into the 90's with that! Free-hit to follow....
Fuller ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards cover. Deandra Dottin dives to her right and does well to stop the ball. Single taken!
Very full, around middle. Rachael Haynes steps down and gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Fuller now, on the pads. Alyssa Healy flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Karishma Ramharack misses her length and serves a full toss, on middle. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps it towards deep backward point for a brace.
Very full, slower through the air, around off. Alyssa Healy steps down the pitch and drives it towards deep cove. The fielder fumbles there and the batter pick up two runs!
Shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.

Anisa Mohammed is down in pain! She was chasing the ball, but she seems to have pulled her hamstring while running. The physio is out there in the middle to check on her and meanwhile, the umpires have called for drinks! It's been only Australia Women so far! They have been maneuvering along nicely and are scoring runs freely. West Indies Women have been sloppy in the field, and have not been able to get a wicket yet.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy is having fun at the moment! A shorter ball, around off. Alyssa Healy stays in her crease and reverse-pulls it towards third man for a boundary.
Short again, on middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, shorter ball. Alyssa Healy cuts it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Slower through the air, full, around middle. Alyssa Healy shimmies down the pitch and tonks it over mid off for a boundary!
Fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Around middle. fuller ball. Alyssa Healy eases it down to long on for a single.

PUT DOWN! Another chance goes down! Nothing is going West Indies Women's way today!  A fuller ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes advances down the pitch and heaves it towards Hayley Matthews at mid on, who drops an absolute dolly. Single taken!
Outside off, fuller ball. Rachael Haynes cuts it towards point.
Loopy delivery, on middle. Alyssa Healy steps down and eases it down to long on for a single.
Full again, slower through the air now, around off. Alyssa Healy steps down once again, and guides it towards point.
FOUR! lovely shot! Fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy dances down the pitch and lifts it over mid off for a cracking boundary.
Short again, on middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes steps down and drags it with the inner half of her bat past mid-wicket. Single taken!
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Rachael Haynes looks to sweep but she misses. Wide called.
Drifting it in on the pads, fuller ball. Rachael Haynes misses her flick and gets hit on the pads.
Shorter ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Slower through the air now, full, on middle. Alyssa Healy works it away towards mid-wicket.
Flatter, outside off, fuller ball. Alyssa Healy looks to cut this away, but she misses.
Fuller, on middle. Alyssa Healy sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! WOW! Perfect execution! A fuller ball, slower through the air, around middle. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps it past point for a boundary.
Outside off, fuller ball. Rachael Haynes cuts it past point. Single taken!
Fuller, around middle. Alyssa Healy drives it towards cover for a single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! West Indies Women cannot afford that! A shorter ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards Shamilia Connell at mid-wicket, who gets her hands to it but fails to grab it. The ball rolls towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Fuller, outside off. Rachael Haynes stays in her crease and tries to cut this but she misses.
FOUR! Not the best ball by Deandra Dottin! On a length, down the leg side. Alyssa Healy flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary. 18 runs off the over!
Another short ball, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it once again, towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Rachael Haynes pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. Rachael Haynes has now scored over 400 runs in this tournament!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around middle. Rachael Haynes ducks underneath it. Wide given for height!
FOUR! Pulled away! Deandra Dottin drops it short again, around off. Rachael Haynes picks up the length, stays back, and smashes it towards deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
Shorter ball now, around middlle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Deandra Dottin pitches it up again, outside off. Alyssa Healy presses forward and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Wide! Fuller in length, down the leg side. Alyssa Healy looks to flick, but she misses. Wide called!
Very full, quicker, on middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
Fraction shorter, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. 50 for Alyssa Healy as well! That's her third half-century of this tournament.
Slower through the air, very full, on middle. Rachael Haynes steps down and knocks it to long off for a single.
Flatter, on middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery, around middle. Alyssa Healy flicks it through square leg for a single. She moves to 49 now!
Pitches it up, tad quicker, outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards point for a single. FIFTY for Rachael Haynes! It's been a fine knock so far, she will want to carry on till the end!
BEATEN! Outside off, fuller. Healy looks to drive but is beaten!
Well fielded! Outside off, Healy cuts, the fielder at point dives to her right and stops it.
Outside off, Healy hits this to covers.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, Haynes guides it to point.
Short and on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.

100 up for the Aussies and they are well on course to a big total here. Excellent from Haynes and Healy. Weathered the storm earlier on and now are cashing in. On middle, this is worked to mid on for one.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Haynes steps out. She swings but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Now takes one by working it through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Takes full toll of the full toss this time. Healy just guides it over backward square leg and into the fence.
Just short! Healy comes down the track, she makes it into a full toss and tries to go over mid off but it lands just short of the fielder there.
Excellent batting and that is 11 from Dottin's first! On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Better from Dottin! Length and on off, blocked.
Misfield! Shorter and on off, Haynes smashes it to point. The fielder only makes a half stop. A single. That was hit really hard.

FOUR! Hammered! Not learning are the Windies bowlers. Yet again bangs it short. Haynes won't mind this, she goes back and smashes it through square leg for the second boundary in the first three balls of this over.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one. A boundary followed by a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Healy feeds on such deliveries! Short and on the body. This is pulled through square leg. Races away.
Deandra Dottin comes to bowl now.
A dot to end! On middle, defended.
On middle, Haynes looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and on middle, this is played down to long on for one.
On middle, Healy works it to mid-wicket.
Three! Healy really pushed Haynes there! Don't think she wanted the third! On middle, this is swept fine on the leg side. They take two, Healy calls for the third and they complete it.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, blocked.
Beaten again! Once again this is angled into off, it lands and spins away. Haynes is beaten again.
Beaten! Angled it into the off pole, this lands and spins away. Haynes is beaten.
Haynes looks to sweep but this time there is extra bounce, she gets a top edge which hits her body and lands safe.
Healy plays the sweep through square leg for one.
Good start from Karishma! On middle, this is whipped wide of mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Haynes plays the sweep, through square leg for one.
Three dots in a row! On off, Haynes pushes it to covers.
On off again, blocked.
Fuller and on off, this is defended.

DRINKS! Rachael Haynes and Alyssa Healy started a bit slowly, but runs have been coming easy for them now. They have respected all the good deliveries and put away the bad ones. It's been good from them. West Indies Women need to break this opening stand and take things under control before it gets late for them. Also, Karishma Ramharack comes into the attack now.
On off, it is pushed to cover. Another expensive over.
This lands on off and spins in. Healy looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! Boundary again! The momentum has completely shifted towards the Aussies! On middle, Healy yet again looks to play the paddle scoop, it goes off the glove but fine on the leg side. Races away.
Hayley fires this one outside off, it is guided to point.
FOUR! This time she gets a boundary. Very clever batting. Just uses the pace of Healy who is firing it in. She plays the paddle sweep quite fine this time on the leg side for a boundary.
More runs. Healy bringing all the shots out now. The paddle sweep, she plays it form outside off and towards fine leg for two.
Well fielded! Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled through square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to her left, slides and does well to keep it down to two.
FOUR! Powered! Anisa is leaking runs. Haynes once again makes good use of her feet. Gets to the pitch of it and slams it down the ground and to the mid on fence.
Uses her feet again, this time strokes it past cover and to the right of long off for two.
Haynes now uses her feet but fails to get it past cover.
Now rocks back to this fractionally short ball and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Wonderful stroke! Healy is starting to find her range here. She steps out, gets to the pitch of it and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Yes she does! Well played by Haynes. Flatter and on off, it bounces extra and also turns away. Haynes does well to play it with soft hands towards first slip.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one. Can she close out the over?
Four dots in a row! Outside off, Healy cuts but to point.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Healy plays it to point.
Well bowled! Sees the batter step out and bowls it shorter. It is defended.
Haynes comes down the track but yorks herself. She jams it back to the bowler. Not the best of starts for Anisa.
Outside off, left alone.
Fifty up for the Aussies and this is a solid start for them. Another full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! Not timed well but hit well enough. Healy steps out and it is a high full toss. Healy looks to smash it over mid on but it goes off the splice but over mid on for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! There was an appeal by the keeper to put the umpire off but to no avail. Down the leg side. Haynes looks to sweep but misses.
A low full toss, it is pushed to mid off.
It will spin from the other end as well! Anisa Mohammed comes into the attack.
Tossed up on off, kept out.
The paddle sweep comes out. It is dragged from outside off down to fine leg for one.
On off, blocked.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, Healy guides it to point.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
Fuller and on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Fuller and on off, this is played to covers.
Chinelle Henry has been putting some sawdust on the landing area since she seems to be slipping.
This is short and very wide outside off, Healy slashes but misses. Wided.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid on.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed past the bowler and down to mid on for one.
Tip and run! Good batting. On off, this is played to cover for one.
Goes past the outside edge again! Outside off, Healy goes after it but is beaten. The length wasn't the right one to drive there.
End of Powerplay 1! There will be 4 fielders allowed to be placed outside the circle now.
Good start then by Hayley! On off, this is pushed to covers.
BEATEN! Lovely bowling. Slows it up and lands it around off, it pitches and spins away. Haynes is beaten as she pushes at it.
Turn yet again! Once again this spins back in sharply form outside off, Healy this time does manage to work it through square leg for one.
Sharp turn there! This lands outside off and spins back in. Healy looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Another flighted delivery on off, defended.
Tossed up on off, Healy blocks it.
Time for some spin! Hayley Matthews comes into the attack.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier! Length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Slammed! Haynes just loves the short ball. This is on her body, she swivels and pulls it past short fine leg. It races away to the fence. Runs flowing now for the Aussies.
Back of a length and on off, blocked.
FOUR! Haynes has really got going now. Top shot. Length and on off, she strokes it on the up through covers for a boundary.
Yet another one on a length, it jags back in. Healy looks to defend but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg for one.
On the pads, this is worked on the leg side for one.

Safe stroke! Short and angling away from middle. Haynes looks to pull but it goes off the splice. It lands safe in the deep square leg region as just the two players are on the leg side. Three taken as it slows down as it gets near the ropes.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
On the pads, Haynes looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the fuller side again, this one tails back in from outside off. Haynes looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge to the bowler.
Fuller and on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Timed well but to point! On off, Haynes opens the face of the bat and guides it to point.
A single to end! On the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! That is a lazy effort from Henry! Fuller and on middle, this is played back uppishly to the right of Henry who sticks a hand out. It hits the fingers and goes towards mid off for one. She was slow to react. Maybe it got to her a lot quickly than she expected. Need to take such chances against the Aussies.
Back of a length and on off, this one comes back in. Healy looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Angled into middle now, it is worked to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Henry has started well. Length and around off. Healy pushes at it but is beaten. She tried to hit it on the up there. Not a good idea on this wicket where there is extra bounce.
A dot to end but a good over for the Aussies! Length and on off, defended.
Misfield and two! Fuller and on off, Haynes strokes it towards cover. The fielder lets it through. There is a sweeper who keeps it down to two.
A little too straight again, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Put away! That will ease the pressure. Poor delivery. Short and on the body with just two on the leg side is a gift. It is pulled down to fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Haynes looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Good length and on off, defended.

NOT OUT! No edge there! Ultra Edge shows a flat line. The noise was the bat hitting the pad. Length and on off, this moves away. Haynes looks to defend but is beaten. A huge appeal but turned down. Reviewed. Replays show that the on-field call is a superb one. Windies lose a review early on.
Review! West Indies Women have reviewed a caught behind decision. No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge.
A dot to end a tidy over! Tidy stuff to begin with by the Windies. Outside off, left alone.
A low full toss on middle, Healy works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, Haynes strokes it down the ground. Mid off does well to move to her left and make a tumbling stop. Only one.
Good length and on off, Haynes plays it to covers.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, Haynes is rooted to her crease as she tries to defend. The ball nips away and goes past the outside edge.
Extra bounce again! Length and on off, this one takes off. Haynes takes a hand off the handle as she tries to defend. The ball hits the splice.
A length ball, width on offer. Alyssa Healy steers it past point. Karishma Ramharack from third man runs to her left, dives, and stops the ball from touching the boundary ropes. Good stop! Two taken!
Fuller in length, outside off. Alyssa Healy leaves it alone.
Wide! Back of a length, shaping away, wide of off. Alyssa Healy offers no shot. Wide called!
Swing and a miss! Another length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy stays in her crease and looks to slash this away but she misses.
Fractions shorter, outside off. Alyssa Healy punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Wide! On a length, wide of off this time. Alyssa Healy lets that go through. Wide given!
Another length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover.

Some extra bounce there! Touch shorter, around middle. Rachael Haynes looks to block this but the ball goes off her gloves towards the off side due to some extra bounce. 5 runs off Chinelle Henry's first over!
Full again, around middle and leg. Rachael Haynes flicks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Much fuller on this occasion, outside off. Rachael Haynes drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy guides it towards third man for a single.
Fraction short again, around middle. Alyssa Healy pulls it past mid-wicket. The ball will not go all the way to the boundary but the batters pick up two runs. Alyssa Healy gets off the mark.
Chinelle Henry begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy taps it towards point.
Chinelle Henry will bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards point off the back foot. A tidy first over!
Tad shorter, around middle. Rachael Haynes blocks it out.
A low full toss, around middle. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards mid off.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rachael Haynes defends it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Rachael Haynes and Australia Women are up and running in style! Shamilia Connell pitches this up, outside off. Rachael Haynes presses forward and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Shamilia Connell begins with a length ball, shaping away, outside off. Rachael Haynes pushes it towards cover off the back foot.

We are ready for action in this big semi-final! The players are out in the middle. Rachael Haynes and Alyssa Healy will open the batting for Australia Women. Shamilia Connell will begin with the new ball. Here we go...

The game is set to begin. Both the teams stride out to the middle and get lined-up for their respective national anthems. First, the national anthem of West Indies will be played followed by Australia's.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Smith and Frankie Mckay are near the pitch. Ian Smith says that the conditions are a bit dewy and there is a tinge of grass on it. Frankie Mckay adds that it will be a big advantage for West Indies since there is some good bounce, carry and seam on this wicket.

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women, says that they are not fussed and the pitch is new and the conditions are going to remain the same throughout the day. Informs that they have no changes and they are playing with the same team. Mentions that it's a semi-final game which is always big and West Indies Women are a very dangerous side. Adds that they are looking forward to the game.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, says that they are going to bowl first, since the pitch has been covered, and with the rain around, they will bowl. Informs that they have one change to their side, Anisa Mohammed comes in for Afy Fletcher. Mentions that it's all about execution today and they will stick to their plans.

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Rachael Haynes, Meg Lanning (C), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Annabel Sutherland, Darcie Brown, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Rashada Williams, Hayley Matthews, Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Kycia Knight, Chinelle Henry, Karishma Ramharack, Shamilia Connell, Anisa Mohammed (In for Afy Fletcher).
TOSS -  West Indies Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

UPDATE 4:35 am IST (11:05 pm GMT, previous day) - YESS! We have good news, folks! The toss is scheduled at 4:45 am IST (11:15 pm, previous day) and the match is set to begin at 5:15 am IST (11:45 pm, previous day). There are some revised playing conditions. It will be a 45-overs per side game, 9 overs of Powerplay, and 5 bowlers can bowl 9 overs each.
So, what if there is no cricket played today? (Let's hope that does not happen). But there has been a reserve day allocated in such a case! There are reserve days for both semi-finals and finals.

UPDATE 4:05 am IST (10:35 pm GMT, previous day) - The wait continues, and hopes are still alive. There is a very light drizzle at Wellington and the covers are still on. But the good news is the weather is starting to clear, and we can expect some action soon. There is an inspection scheduled at 4:30 am IST (11:00 pm GMT, previous day). Let's hope we get some good news!

UPDATE 3:00 am IST (9:30 pm GMT, previous day) -  It is drizzling at the moment in Wellington, and the covers are on, and there has been a slight delay. But the forecast is not all bad ahead, so let's hope we see some action soon. However, for now, the toss has been delayed.

West Indies Women have displayed their magic with the ball but they have not shown their true potential with the bat. They will have to step up and score big runs in this big encounter. West Indies Women will be without their spinner, Afy Fletcher in this clash, since she has been ruled out after testing positive for COVID. Both teams will be coming out all guns blazing in this important clash. Who will seal a spot in the final? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

There is no doubt that Australia Women have been the best team so far. They have remained unbeaten so far and they will want to stick to their plans and carry on the winning momentum to seal a spot in the final. However, coming into this game they will be without one of their best player, Ellyse Perry who has been ruled out due to injury.

Drama, thrillers, entertainment, we have witnessed everything in the round-robin stage and after 28 such games, we are finally into the semi-finals of the Women’s World Cup 2022. It will be Australia Women taking on West Indies Women in the first semi-final of this tournament. Both teams have fought hard and have done well to reach this stage but they will have to put their best foot forward to progress to the final. On that note, welcome to our coverage.
